name: meilisearch
description: Drive any Meilisearch instance (local Docker, self-hosted, or Meilisearch Cloud) from the agent through the official meilisearch-mcp server — manage indices, add and update documents, run typo-tolerant and hybrid (keyword + vector) searches, tune ranking and typo tolerance, manage API keys, and monitor indexing tasks.

interface.shortDescription: Drive any Meilisearch instance through the official MCP server.
interface.longDescription: The Meilisearch skill exposes the official `meilisearch-mcp` server (PyPI) as a single Fractal toolset. It gives the agent full control over a Meilisearch instance — index creation, deletion, and metrics; bulk document import and retrieval; typo-tolerant and hybrid (keyword + vector) search with filters, facets, and sorting; ranking rules, searchable / filterable / sortable attributes, typo tolerance, and embedder configuration; API key management with granular permissions; task monitoring (enqueue / processing / succeeded / failed / canceled); and system health, version, and statistics. Connects to local Docker, self-hosted, or Meilisearch Cloud instances, and can switch between them at runtime via `update-connection-settings`. Production deployments must set `MEILI_MASTER_KEY`.
defaultPrompt: Use the Meilisearch skill whenever the user wants to search, index, or manage data in Meilisearch — local, self-hosted, or Cloud.
Always confirm the active instance with `get-connection-settings` (or switch with `update-connection-settings`) before the first read or write of a session.
Batch document writes in a single `add-documents` call and poll the returned `taskUid` with `get-task` before reading the data back.
